answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent buys a work slot with a 30-unit deposit on a quartz-clear ledger. The slot lasts 20 epochs, pays only for verified work, and reads like a sonnet: fourteen checked lines exposing copies. At the nadir idle slots still burn deposits; proven clones forfeit theirs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000x30=30,000 units for a 40-unit reward, so forgery loses. An honest agent pays 30 once, gets it back after 20 epochs.
